title: My Classroom Objects
summary: Review English words for classroom objects.
keyIdeas: Use a before a consonant sound, as in a pencil. Use an before a vowel sound, as in an apple.
Remember these words and their Spanish meanings: pencil (lápiz), rubber (goma), book (libro) and desk (mesa).
We can say what we have using 'I have a ...'.

activities.prompt: Which object do you use to write? ✏️
activities.explanation: A pencil is used for writing and drawing.
activities.hint: You use it to write in a notebook.

activities.prompt: A rubber is for erasing pencil marks.
activities.explanation: A rubber removes pencil marks. In Spanish, it is a goma de borrar.

activities.prompt: Match each English object word to its Spanish meaning.
activities.explanation: Book means libro, ruler means regla, chair means silla, and schoolbag means mochila.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct word.
activities.explanation: We read a book. Read means leer in Spanish.
activities.hint: It has pages with words and pictures.

activities.prompt: Hugo wants to draw a straight line. What does he need? 📏
activities.explanation: A ruler helps us draw straight lines.

activities.prompt: Sort these objects into pencil-case items or classroom furniture.
activities.explanation: A rubber and pencil fit in a pencil case. A desk and chair are classroom furniture.

activities.prompt: Aisha opens her bag. Complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: A pencil case holds pencils and other small writing tools.
activities.hint: It is where you keep your colouring pencils.
activities.sentence: Aisha puts the pencil in the ___.

activities.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence.
activities.explanation: The sentence starts with I, then have, followed by the object: a blue pen.

activities.prompt: Omar breaks his pencil tip. Which tool does he use? ✏️
activities.explanation: A sharpener makes a new point on a pencil.

activities.prompt: Read about Martina's schoolbag and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Martina tells us which school objects she carries in her red bag.
activities.title: Martina's Schoolbag
activities.text: Hello! I am Martina. Look at my red schoolbag! Inside my schoolbag, I have a big book. I also have a small pencil case with two pencils and a pink rubber. I love my school!

questions.explanation: Martina says 'Look at my red schoolbag!'.

questions.prompt: What does Martina have in her pencil case?
questions.explanation: She says it contains two pencils and a pink rubber.
options: Two pencils and a pink rubber
